meta_description: 30A ESCAPES presents... “Hidden Gem #6,” your ideal retreat in Seacrest West! Located in the Arcadia Community, this two-story duplex offers a welcoming getaway with beach access just a 2-minute walk or 1-minute bike ride away and a community pool just steps from
description_expanded: Description Description 30A ESCAPES presents... “Hidden Gem #6,” your ideal retreat in Seacrest West! Located in the Arcadia Community, this two-story duplex offers a welcoming getaway with beach access just a 2-minute walk or 1-minute bike ride away and a community pool just steps from your door. With 3 bedrooms, a balcony featuring peek-a-boo Gulf views and modern amenities like Roku Smart TVs, it's designed for a comfortable and relaxing stay. Spend your mornings enjoying the sugar-white sands of 30A, then hop on one of the 4 included bikes to explore Scenic Highway 30A and nearby favorites like The Big Chill, Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Ready to plan your escape? Learn more below...👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Nearby Beach Access: Enjoy the sugar-white sands and emerald Gulf waters of 30A with beach access just a 2-minute walk or 1-minute bike ride from the home.Inviting Community Pool Just Steps Away: Relax and unwind beside the pool, conveniently located near the property.Peek-a-Boo Gulf Views from the Balcony: Enjoy glimpses of the sparkling Gulf waters from your private balcony.4 Bikes Included: Explore Scenic Highway 30A, nearby neighborhoods and local attractions at your own pace.High-Speed Internet & Roku Smart TVs: Stay connected and enjoy streaming your favorite shows during cozy nights in.Prime Seacrest West Location: Conveniently located near Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach and The Big Chill for shopping, dining and entertainment.Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "Loved the peaceful location just steps from the beach and close to bike-friendly paths to Alys and Rosemary Beach. Great spot for shopping, dining, and a relaxing getaway!"– JT S.⭐ "First visit to 30A and it was perfect — peaceful area, easy beach access, and a short bike ride to Alys and Rosemary Beach for shopping and dining. Would definitely recommend!" – Maggie B.⭐ "One of the best locations we've had in 5 years on 30A — quiet beach right across the street!" – Tyler M.*** LIVING AREA ***Designed with relaxation in mind, the open-concept living area on the second floor welcomes guests with peek-a-boo Gulf views and plenty of natural light. Cozy up on the plush sofa and enjoy your favorite shows on the Smart Roku TV, or unwind with a good book in the charming seating nook while the coastal breeze wafts in from the balcony. After a morning at the beach, it's a comfortable place to settle in and enjoy a relaxing afternoon together.Spacious Open-Concept Living Area: Enjoy a bright, inviting layout with glimpses of the sparkling Gulf waters and plenty of room to gather.Comfortable Coastal Seating: Relax on the plush sofa or settle into the cozy seating nook with a good book.Roku Smart TV: Stream your favorite movies and shows with access to Hulu and Netflix.Private Balcony Access: Step outside to enjoy the coastal breeze and beautiful peek-a-boo Gulf views.*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need, whether you're preparing a family dinner or a quick snack between activities. Featuring granite countertops, stainless steel appliances and plenty of seating, it's a welcoming space to cook and enjoy meals together. Gather around the dining table after a day along the Gulf or enjoy an evening meal outdoors on the balcony.Fully Equipped Kitchen: Modern kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances and everything needed for preparing meals throughout your stay.Granite Countertops & Breakfast Bar: Enjoy generous counter space for meal preparation and additional seating for 3 at the breakfast bar.Spacious Dining Accommodations: Gather around the dining table with comfortable seating for up to 8 guests.Outdoor Balcony Dining: Enjoy morning coffee, lunch or an evening meal outdoors with seating for 4 and beautiful coastal surroundings.*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***With three inviting bedrooms spread across two floors, “Hidden Gem #6” offers comfortable accommodations for families and friends enjoying a getaway along 30A. The first floor features a spacious Primary King Suite and a bunk room, while the second-floor King Guest Suite provides another relaxing retreat. With convenient bathroom access on both floors, everyone has space to get ready for a day at the beach or unwind after exploring the area.1st FloorPrimary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, porch access and En-Suite with dual vanities & shower/tub comboBunk Room: Twin-over-Queen bunk bed, flat-screen TV and access to shared guest bathroom with single vanity & shower/tub combo2nd FloorKing Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV and access to shared guest bathroom with single vanity & walk-in shower*** OUTDOOR & COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***The Arcadia Community offers a peaceful setting with the beach just a 2-minute walk or 1-minute bike ride from “Hidden Gem #6.” Spend your mornings along the Gulf before returning for a relaxing afternoon at the nearby community pool. Enjoy coffee or dinner on your private balcony overlooking the coastal surroundings, or take advantage of the four provided bikes to explore Scenic Highway 30A and its neighboring communities.Nearby Beach Access: Just a 2-minute walk or 1-minute bike ride from the home, making it easy to enjoy the beautiful beaches of 30A throughout your stay.Community Pool: Located just steps from the property, offering a convenient place to swim and relax in the Florida sunshine.Private Balcony: Enjoy outdoor dining for 4, fresh coastal air and peek-a-boo Gulf views.4 Beach Bikes Included: Explore Scenic Highway 30A and the surrounding coastal communities at your own pace.*** NEARBY ATTRACTIONS ***Located along Scenic Highway 30A, “Hidden Gem #6” offers a convenient home base for enjoying the beautiful beaches of Seacrest West and discovering the area's favorite restaurants, shops and entertainment. Spend the morning relaxing along the Gulf before exploring the beautiful architecture of Alys Beach, browsing the boutiques of Rosemary Beach or enjoying live music and family-friendly activities at The Big Chill.The Big Chill: A lively gathering spot with restaurants, live music, shopping and family-friendly entertainment.Alys Beach: Beautiful white architecture, local dining and scenic green spaces.Rosemary Beach: Charming streets, boutique shopping, coffee shops and restaurants.Seaside: Colorful cottages, outdoor markets, local shops and dining.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Parking available for 2 vehiclesThere is an active camera located at the top left corner facing the front door area.Waiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.LSV (Low Speed Vehicles) are NOT allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.*** YOUR STAY – OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 guest support and an immaculate home designed for comfort, connection, and coastal charm.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 203974STRO #: STR-203974 Read less
